name: Wells Fargo Active Cash® Credit Card

localized_names.en: Wells Fargo Active Cash® Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers on the marketed offer; then 18.49%, 24.49% or 28.49% variable APR.

fx_fee.notes: 3% fee for each foreign transaction converted to USD per Wells Fargo FAQ/Important Credit Terms.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem via Wells Fargo Rewards (statement credit, Pay with Rewards, gift cards, etc.).

signup_bonus.description: $200 cash rewards bonus after spending $500 in the first 3 months; offers may differ by channel.

benefits.title: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 cell phone protection against damage or theft subject to a $25 deductible when the monthly wireless bill is paid with the eligible card.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursement for covered damage or theft on eligible rentals paid with the card.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: 24/7 Visa Signature Concierge for travel, dining, and event assistance.

notes: Flat-rate cash-back Visa Signature card; intro APR and bonus offers are channel-dependent.
